title: Valuation coverage and evidence-acquisition phase
objective: Shift from UI work back to autonomous data coverage while keeping modeled values fail-closed.

steps.title: Separate direct-provider coverage from modeled proposals
Prioritize missing direct evidence by expected copies per case
Expose modeled-gate blockers in acquisition tasks
Cap operational acquisition queue at top 100 tasks

guarantees: Tier C/D confidence gates remain fail-closed.
The acquisition queue is research ordering only and is not a value ranking.
